title: Marketing Internship / 12 Month Placement
description:
Overview

We're Enterprise Mobility. A family-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we're built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business.

Join us, and as this year's Higherin Best Student Employer and a Times Top 100 Graduate Employer, we'll offer you the freedom to explore your potential. Ready to make your move?

We are excited to announce the opportunity to join our Marketing and Communications Team overseeing our Car Club operations at Enterprise Mobility' European Head Office in Egham, Surrey.

If you are looking to get a holistic understanding as to how different marketing strategies, mechanics and tactics converge to propel a brand and business forwards, whilst being given a tangible role in making it all happen, this internship is for you.

As the Enterprise Car Club (ECC) intern, you'll not only understand our overall approach, but you'll take ownership of your own projects, get exposure to a wide range of activities and have genuine voice within the team.

This internship position would suit someone keen to fully understand a brand's full marketing ecosystem, getting directly involved in projects spanning both digital and non-digital channels.

This person needs to be good understanding complex problems, getting to grips with new software swiftly and handling complex data/spreadsheets. On top of a head for numbers the ideal candidate would be comfortable when managing more creative elements, for example copy writing with an ability to draft website/email copy using the brand's voice, and appraising creative design work. To do this all well they must be organized, reliable and have an eagle eye for detail.

The ECC Marketing Intern will support the implementation marketing strategies and tactics and be giving responsibility to deliver key elements. They will also be encouraged to contribute their own original and innovative ideas. The team has a start-up feel and is looking for someone dynamic and entrepreneurially minded get stuck-in, be 'can-do' and make a tangible difference.

This role will join an existing ECC Marketing team will and work with a number of third-party marketing and fulfillment agencies, as well as a wealth of internal stakeholders across the wider EU Marketing and ECC Operations team.

Responsibilities
- Support organic and paid social strategies - working directly on our owned channels (suggesting posts, creating image/copy for posts and monitoring performance) and also working with a third-party social agency on larger paid activity
- Assist the delivery of different promotional mechanics - supporting the set-up of the fulfilment processes, origination of creative, working with Legal to create T&Cs, monitoring performance, and suggesting improvements
- Coordinate and support implementation of national and geo-tailored marketing projects as assigned - e.g., direct mail, door drop, local press, geo-specific social.
- Coordinate the production of creative designs and printed materials - receiving requests from the business, briefing creative studio/agency, reviewing designs, overseeing production/filming, managing stakeholder approvals, working with suppliers to arrange production and managing costs
- Assisting with updates to web pages and ECC mobile app using Adobe Experience Manager
- Copyright member comms - email, mobile app message, blog posts, website content
- Assist with email marketing campaigns learning to use specialist email delivery software
- Collate and support the interrogation of performance metrics and reporting - obtaining data from our in-house software, inputting it into spreadsheets/reports and learning to extract insight/meaning
- Respond to third party enquiries from stakeholders internally and externally. Internally this will involve liaising with the different regional ECC/ERAC (Enterprise Rent-A-Car) teams whose requirements will vary location to location.
- Assist in managing the various software platforms that are used within the department including Trello, AEM, CANVA, Production files
- Desk research, for example researching local marketing tactics, channels, community events and possible brand partners.
- Provide general support to Marketing Team as needed
- Perform miscellaneous job-related duties and special marketing projects as assigned

Qualifications
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-driven and motivated
- The ability to work independently and achieve results
- Able to multitask juggling a number of complex projects simultaneously while managing time effectively
- Have a keen interest in the holistic marketing mix
- An aptitude for numbers & analytics (Microsoft Excel skills preferred, although not essential)
- Digital & tech savvy - familiar with different social/digital channels, with an aptitude to quickly pick-up a number of new digital programmes
- Current Marketing Undergraduate
- Basic experience of graphic design or web packages such as illustrator, InDesign, CANVA, Adobe Experient Manager (preferred, although not essential)

Additional Information
- Hours: 40 per week
- Salary: £22,600 per annum
- Duration: The Internship will run from Summer 2026
- Location: Egham, Surrey, TW20 9 FB (Plenty of free on site parking and approx. 10 minutes walk from Egham station)

title: Senior Legacy Marketing Manager
company: Compassion in World Farming International (CIWF) - Agency - Permanent
description:
Compassion in World Farming International is a global movement transforming the future of food and farming. Lead our UK and international legacy marketing programme and help inspire supporters to leave a lasting gift for farm animals, people and the planet.

Senior Legacy Marketing Manager (UK and International)

Role type:Full time; Permanent

Location:Godalming, Surrey - HQ. Hybrid working pattern 2x days per week in the office: Tuesdays & Thursdays. The office is located close to Godalming station, with direct trains from/to London Waterloo in approximately 45 minutes.

Salary: £45,000 to £50,000 per annum (depending upon skills and experience)

About the role

As our Senior Legacy Marketing Manager (UK and International), you'll lead the strategic development and delivery of Compassion in World Farming's legacy marketing programme across the UK and internationally. This is a vital role within our Global Fundraising team, helping to shape a sector leading legacy strategy that inspires supporters to leave a lasting gift for farm animals and the planet.

As part of this exciting role, you'll be responsible for:
- Legacy strategy and coordination - Leading the development of Compassion's UK and international legacy marketing strategy, reporting on KPIs and identifying opportunities to strengthen engagement and investment.
- UK legacy marketing delivery - Overseeing and delivering legacy communications across direct mail, email, social media, website content, events, supporter engagement and promotional campaigns.
- International legacy delivery - Supporting fundraising teams in France, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, the USA and Poland to deliver locally relevant legacy campaigns, content, training and enquiry handling.
- Supporter care - Responding sensitively and efficiently to legacy enquiries and helping colleagues feel confident talking to supporters about gifts in wills.

About you

To succeed as our Senior Legacy Marketing Manager (UK and International), you'll be a confident and strategic legacy marketing professional with a strong track record of delivering impactful campaigns that inspire supporters to leave a very special gift. You'll bring a deep understanding of legacy fundraising, ideally gained within the charity or NGO sector, and feel comfortable working across both UK and international markets.

You'll be highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to craft compelling messages for direct response and manage multi-channel campaigns.

Skills and experience you'll need to bring as part of this role:
- Track record and knowledge of legacy marketing and legacy strategy, ideally as a practitioner.
- Strong understanding of direct marketing, digital marketing or supporter fundraising, with excellent copywriting and creative skills.
- Proven strategic planning skills, with the ability to manage budgets, suppliers, data and reporting.
- Experience of working collaboratively with international teams across multiple countries and time zones.
- Ability to engage supporters with sensitivity, care and confidence, including through legacy events and enquiry handling.
- Proficiency in relevant fundraising or database systems, ideally Salesforce CRM.
- A demonstrable interest in farm animal welfare issues and Compassion's mission.

If you don't meet every requirement but believe you could thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply.

About Compassion

Compassion in World Farming International is a leading global organisation working to end factory farming. Founded in 1967 by British farmer Peter Roberts, we've spent over 50 years driving change, successfully campaigning to ban cruel practices such as barren battery cages, veal crates, and sow stalls across the UK and Europe.

Our work combines advocacy, campaigning, and collaboration with policymakers and businesses to promote animal welfare and sustainable food systems. We envision a future where animals are treated with compassion, and farming supports both people and the planet. To learn more about our mission, culture, and opportunities, please explore our Candidate Pack, and Careers Page on our website.

To comply with legal requirements in the UK and internationally, all applicants must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the country where the role is based.

Compassion in World Farming is absolutely committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone regardless of their background. We value diversity and live experience and acknowledge the underrepresentation of people from certain backgrounds, both within our organisation and across the sector. We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, whether these be of ethnicity, gender, identity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation or other.
